# Figure captions

This article describes several photographs, their captions and their alternative descriptions. Each figure should keep its own image and the information that belongs with it.

[![](https://example.com/same.jpg)](https://example.com/full.jpg)

A bright & clear _screen._

![A laptop viewed from the side.](https://example.com/different.jpg "Side view")

The ports are on the left.

![](https://example.com/whitespace.jpg)

A distant mountain.

![A captionless image.](https://example.com/no-caption.jpg "Keep this title")

![Keep this description.](https://example.com/empty-caption.jpg)

![US](https://example.com/case.jpg)

us

The descriptions that differ from their captions matter to the reader. Empty captions and images outside figures must keep their alternative text as well.

![Outside the figure.](https://example.com/outside.jpg)
